description: Check one structured invoice before it is sent: Peppol fields, totals and both VAT numbers in EU VIES, with a fix per finding and the UBL XML. It never sends, and a VAT check VIES did not answer is `unknown`, never a pass. It does not look the receiver up: check_peppol_ready does. 8 credits (EUR 0.08) per review the VAT register answered; needs a bearer token.

buyerReference.description: Buyer reference (BT-10), e.g. a PO or cost-centre code.

customer.description: Buyer / accounting customer party, including an optional draft e-mail recipient.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (uppercase), e.g. BE.

endpointId.description: Peppol participant endpoint identifier, e.g. a GLN.

endpointScheme.description: Endpoint scheme id (EAS code), e.g. "0208" for a Belgian enterprise number or "0088" for a GLN.

lineNetAmount.description: Caller-stated line total excluding VAT (BT-131), used by the shared Peppol arithmetic rules.

lineTotal.description: Caller-stated line total excluding VAT, compared with quantity × unit price by this review.

taxCategory.description: Override the derived UNCL5305 VAT category.

orderReference.description: Purchase order reference (BT-13). Peppol requires this OR a buyer reference.

payment.description: Payment instruction carried by the invoice, when it names an IBAN.

supplier.description: Seller / accounting supplier party, including an optional IBAN for the payment check.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (uppercase), e.g. BE.

endpointId.description: Peppol participant endpoint identifier, e.g. a GLN.

endpointScheme.description: Endpoint scheme id (EAS code), e.g. "0208" for a Belgian enterprise number or "0088" for a GLN.

totalVat.description: Caller-stated total VAT (BT-110), used by the arithmetic rule checks.

totalWithVat.description: Caller-stated invoice total including VAT (BT-112), used by the arithmetic rule checks.

totalWithoutVat.description: Caller-stated invoice total excluding VAT (BT-109), used by the arithmetic rule checks.

name: review_invoice
